// diagnostic E1007

Jet.InvalidBitWidth

Malformed bit width in an `[U8]{"…"}` binary pattern hole — not `U<1..64>[be|le]` or `...`

What

Malformed bit width in an `[U8]{"…"}` binary pattern hole — not `U<1..64>[be|le]` or `...`

Why

A binary pattern hole names how many bits it reads, from 1 to 64, with an optional byte order

Fix

Use a width `U<1..64>[be|le]` or the `...` hole form.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidBitWidth: Tests/UI/binpat_bad_width.stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidBitWidth: `U99` isn't a valid bit width in a binary pattern
  --> Tests/UI/binpat_bad_width.jet:4:18
    |
  4 |         [U8]{"{x:U99}"} -> { print("x") }
    |                  ^^^
 Why: A bit field is `U` followed by a width of 1 to 64 bits, optionally with a `be`/`le` byte order
 Fix: Write e.g. `U4`, `U8`, `U16be`, or `U32le`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.InvalidBitWidth
